description: Destructive guard (opt-in): denies or asks before destructive Bash commands such as recursive rm of root paths, git discards, SQL drops, and infra teardown. Comment lint: flags wrapped, overlong, banner, and multi-line block comments added by Edit/Write. Arc reload: re-injects the arc rules after compaction when /arc-kit:arc ran this session

hooks.command: set -f; set -- $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_DESTRUCTIVE_GUARD_ENABLED; case "$*" in [Tt][Rr][Uu][Ee]|1|[Yy][Ee][Ss]|[Oo][Nn]) exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/destructive-guard.py";; esac
